name: Bonsai 2.9.1
body:
This is the first service release in the 2.9 series, focused on stabilizing the new editor experience introduced in 2.9.0. It collects a broad set of bug fixes and refinements reported by the community since 2.9.0, spanning the package manager, workflow navigation and breadcrumbs, visualizer layouts, and command line handling. Please continue to share any feedback in the comments below or by opening a new discussion.

## What's Changed

### 🎉 New Features

* Add --debug flag to enable headless debugger by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2550
* Improve package manager keyboard navigation by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2591
* Add machine learning icon by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2350

### 🐞 Bug Fixes

* Add missing editor default properties by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2358
* Ensure CLI paths are validated and resolved early by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2359
* Fix tooltip for `New` workflow button on toolbar by @banchan86 in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2364
* Fix search filter to allow legacy package update by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2366
* Apply visualizer window state independently of saved bounds by @bruno-f-cruz in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2583
* Fix duplicate and missing package dependencies during environment initialization by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2587
* Fix package manager keyboard and search interactions by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2589
* Await editor extensions before auto-starting a workflow by @bruno-f-cruz in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2593
* Launch specified visualizers correctly without the debugger by @bruno-f-cruz in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2594
* Skip invalid visualizer layout on headless launch by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2603
* Clarify visualizer layout error messages by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2604
* Fix stylesheet import in docs template by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2605
* Make license dialog a true modal window by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2606
* Suppress toolbox search focus while running by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2607
* Fix toolbox search cue banner and focus race by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2609
* Reset toolbox search when renaming subjects by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2610
* Skip invalid operator icon when rendering by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2612
* Hide non-browsable members in member selector by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2613
* Reject extra command line arguments by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2614
* Keep breadcrumb order on nested layout restore by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2619
* Sync dock tab and breadcrumb on save and rename by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2620
* Distinguish unknown operators from obsolete ones by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2622
* Report missing or invalid workflow file on launch by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2623
* Avoid repeating CLI property assignments on reload by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2625
* Avoid coercing numeric values into arrays by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2626
* Compare tuples by value in equality operators by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2627
* Show updates for local package sources by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2628

### 🚀 Performance Improvements

* Avoid blocking WithLatestFrom value updates by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2630

### 🔧 Engineering

* Update spelling of open source to match convention by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2353
* Rename save workflow extension menu item by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2363
* Move scripting package into separate repository by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2439
* Add specification proposal template by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2561
* Add bug report and feature request templates by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2586
* Update workflow actions to Node 24 majors by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2631
* Publish to NuGet.org via trusted publishing by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2632
* Bump template versions to 2.9.1 by @glopesdev in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2633

## New Contributors
* @banchan86 made their first contribution in https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/pull/2364

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bonsai-rx/bonsai/compare/2.9.0...2.9.1
